import re
import pandas as pd
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

spark.conf.set("spark.sql.execution.arrow.pyspark.enabled", "true")   # faster toPandas, handles NaT
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 500, "display.width", 250)

ROOT    = "abfss://apmt-elz@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/"
MH_PATH = ROOT + "silver/moves"                       # Move History (Delta)
PC_PATH = ROOT + "silver/unit_position_correction"    # N4 events incl. position corrections (Delta)
OUT     = ROOT + "sandbox/hk_analysis_2/"

# Move History: spec field -> column in silver/moves
MH = dict(unit="Unit_Nbr", event="Event_Type_Id", move_kind="Move_Kind", to_loc="To_Location",
          frm="From_Position_Name", to="To_Position_Name", t_fetch="t_fetch", t_put="t_put",
          category="Category_Id", freight="Freight_Kind_Id")

# Position corrections: spec field -> column
PC = dict(unit="container_nbr", event="event", frm="from_position", to="to_position",
          ts="time_of_event", status="status", source_file="source_file")

# value filters (compared in UPPER case)
YARD_EVENT, LOAD_EVENT, CORR_EVENT = "UNIT_YARD_MOVE", "UNIT_LOAD", "UNIT_POSITION_CORRECTION"
YARD_MOVE_KINDS, YARD_TO_LOC = ["YARD"], ["YARD"]
LOAD_MOVE_KINDS, LOAD_TO_LOC = ["LOAD"], ["VESSEL"]
EXPORT_VALS    = ["EXPRT", "EXPORT"]
FCL_MH, FCL_PC = "FCL", "FCL"            # Freight_Kind_Id (MH) / status (PC)

# position rules
ALLOW_DOT_TIER  = False                  # True = accept slots like Y-PEB-G31310K.5 (decide after cell 3)
STD = r"^Y-PEB-[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{3}\d{2}[A-Z]" + (r"\.?\d$" if ALLOW_DOT_TIER else r"\d$")
PRESTAGE_BLOCKS = ["G229", "G231", "G329", "G429"]
PRESTAGE_PREFIX = ["RS", "RE", "RR"]

# time windows
DEDUP_MOVE  = pd.Timedelta("10min")
DEDUP_LOAD  = pd.Timedelta("2h")
LOAD_WINDOW = pd.Timedelta("2h")

# reporting
GO_LIVE        = pd.Timestamp("2026-09-28")   # W0 Monday
MIN_LOADS_WEEK = 100
PERIOD         = "auto"    # "auto" = days covered by BOTH sources, or e.g. ("2026-08-03", "2026-10-25")
EXCLUDE_DAYS   = []        # incomplete days from the cell 3 coverage table, e.g. ["2026-10-13"]

def is_prestage(s):
    return s.str[6:10].isin(PRESTAGE_BLOCKS) | s.str[6:8].isin(PRESTAGE_PREFIX)

def to_ts(s):
    """Timestamp or text ('2026-10-31T02:25:58.0000000', '2026-02-06 11:54:52.333') -> datetime64 (seconds)."""
    if isinstance(s.dtype, pd.DatetimeTZDtype):
        return s.dt.tz_localize(None).astype("datetime64[ns]")
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(s):
        return s.astype("datetime64[ns]")
    t = s.astype(str).str.strip().str.replace("T", " ", regex=False).str[:19]
    out = pd.to_datetime(t, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", errors="coerce")
    rest = out.isna() & ~t.isin(["", "None", "nan", "NaT"])
    if rest.any():
        out[rest] = pd.to_datetime(t[rest], errors="coerce", dayfirst=True)
    return out

def up(c):
    return F.upper(F.trim(F.col(c).cast("string")))

mh_raw = spark.read.format("delta").load(MH_PATH)
pc_raw = spark.read.format("delta").load(PC_PATH)
if PC.get("source_file") and PC["source_file"] not in pc_raw.columns:
    PC.pop("source_file")
for name, raw, m in (("Move History", mh_raw, MH), ("Corrections", pc_raw, PC)):
    miss = [v for v in m.values() if v not in raw.columns]
    assert not miss, f"{name}: column(s) not found {miss}. Available: {raw.columns}"

# Move History: filter in Spark first (silver/moves holds every event), then pandas
mh = (mh_raw
      .where(up(MH["event"]).isin(YARD_EVENT, LOAD_EVENT)
             & up(MH["category"]).isin(EXPORT_VALS)
             & (up(MH["freight"]) == FCL_MH))
      .select(*[F.col(v).alias(k) for k, v in MH.items()])
      .toPandas())
for c in ["unit", "event", "move_kind", "to_loc", "frm", "to", "category", "freight"]:
    mh[c] = mh[c].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
fetch, put = to_ts(mh.pop("t_fetch")), to_ts(mh.pop("t_put"))
mh["ts"] = fetch.fillna(put)                       # spec: Fetch Time, else Put Time
mh["ts_src"] = "t_fetch"
mh.loc[fetch.isna(), "ts_src"] = "t_put"
mh.loc[mh.ts.isna(), "ts_src"] = "none"
print(f"Move History (export FCL yard moves + loads): {len(mh):,} rows")

# Corrections + N4 loads (all statuses kept for the checks; FCL filter applied in cell 4)
pc = (pc_raw.where(up(PC["event"]).isin(CORR_EVENT, LOAD_EVENT))
      .select(*[F.col(v).alias(k) for k, v in PC.items()])
      .toPandas())
pc["ts"] = to_ts(pc["ts"])
for c in ["unit", "event", "frm", "to", "status"]:
    pc[c] = pc[c].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
if "source_file" not in pc:
    pc["source_file"] = "delta"
print(f"Corrections table (corrections + loads): {len(pc):,} rows")

ym_all = mh[mh.event == YARD_EVENT]
ld_all = mh[mh.event == LOAD_EVENT]
pcc    = pc[(pc.event == CORR_EVENT) & (pc.status == FCL_PC)]

print("1) Value mix (check the event / move kind / location / category / freight values)")
display(mh_raw.where(up(MH["event"]).isin(YARD_EVENT, LOAD_EVENT))
        .groupBy(*[up(MH[k]).alias(k) for k in ("event", "move_kind", "to_loc", "category", "freight")])
        .count().orderBy(F.desc("count")))
display(pc_raw.groupBy(up(PC["event"]).alias("event"), up(PC["status"]).alias("status"))
        .count().orderBy(F.desc("count")))

print("2) Timestamps")
print("   MH time taken from:", mh.ts_src.value_counts().to_dict())
print("   PC unparsed:", int(pc.ts.isna().sum()))

print("\n3) Position formats (share of rows)")
STD_STRICT = r"^Y-PEB-[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{3}\d{2}[A-Z]\d$"
STD_DOT    = r"^Y-PEB-[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{3}\d{2}[A-Z]\.\d$"
for label, s in (("MH yard move from", ym_all.frm), ("MH load from", ld_all.frm),
                 ("PC correction from", pcc.frm), ("PC correction to", pcc.to)):
    print(f"   {label:<20} standard {s.str.match(STD_STRICT).mean():6.1%}   dot-tier {s.str.match(STD_DOT).mean():6.1%}")
mask = lambda s: s.str.replace(r"[A-Z]", "A", regex=True).str.replace(r"\d", "9", regex=True)
print("   Top NON-standard 'from' patterns in corrections (A = letter, 9 = digit):")
print(mask(pcc.frm[~pcc.frm.str.match(STD_STRICT)]).value_counts().head(10).to_string())

print("\n4) Time alignment in hours (most should be 0; a cluster at +/-2 or 4 = time zone mismatch)")
def align(a, b, on):
    p = a.merge(b, on=on)
    p["diff_h"] = (p.t_pc - p.t_mh).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
    p = p[p.diff_h.abs() <= 12]
    return len(p), p.diff_h.round().value_counts().head(3).to_dict()
print("   yard move vs correction (same unit + from):",
      align(ym_all[["unit", "frm", "ts"]].rename(columns={"ts": "t_mh"}),
            pcc[["unit", "frm", "ts"]].rename(columns={"ts": "t_pc"}), ["unit", "frm"]))
pcl = pc[(pc.event == LOAD_EVENT) & (pc.status == FCL_PC)]
if len(pcl):
    print("   load vs load (same unit):",
          align(ld_all[["unit", "ts"]].rename(columns={"ts": "t_mh"}),
                pcl[["unit", "ts"]].rename(columns={"ts": "t_pc"}), ["unit"]))

print("\n5) Daily coverage (export FCL)")
day = lambda s: s.dt.date
cov = pd.DataFrame({
    "mh_first": mh.groupby(day(mh.ts)).ts.min().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    "mh_last":  mh.groupby(day(mh.ts)).ts.max().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    "mh_yard":  ym_all.groupby(day(ym_all.ts)).size(),
    "mh_loads": ld_all.groupby(day(ld_all.ts)).size(),
    "pc_corr":  pcc.groupby(day(pcc.ts)).size(),
    "pc_first": pcc.groupby(day(pcc.ts)).ts.min().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    "pc_last":  pcc.groupby(day(pcc.ts)).ts.max().dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
})
cov["corr_per_100_loads"] = (100 * cov.pc_corr / cov.mh_loads).round(0)
print(cov.to_string())

print("\n6) Correction density per source file (40–180 per 100 loads = full extract; ~7 = daily 'Rehandles' report)")
loads_per_day = ld_all.groupby(day(ld_all.ts)).size()
pf = (pcc.assign(d=day(pcc.ts)).groupby("source_file")
         .agg(first_day=("d", "min"), last_day=("d", "max"), days=("d", "nunique"), corrections=("unit", "size")))
pf["mh_loads_same_days"] = [loads_per_day.reindex(pcc.loc[pcc.source_file == f, "ts"].dt.date.unique()).sum()
                            for f in pf.index]
pf["corr_per_100_loads"] = (100 * pf.corrections / pf.mh_loads_same_days.where(pf.mh_loads_same_days > 0)).round(0)
print(pf.to_string())

s, e = max(mh.ts.min(), pcc.ts.min()), min(mh.ts.max(), pcc.ts.max())
print(f"\n7) Period covered by BOTH sources (used when PERIOD='auto'): {s:%Y-%m-%d} -> {e:%Y-%m-%d}")

def keep(d, mask, label):
    out = d[mask]
    print(f"   {label:<30}{len(out):>9,}   (-{len(d) - len(out):,})")
    return out

pcf = pc[pc.status == FCL_PC]

# ---------- Step 1: moves ----------
ym = mh[(mh.event == YARD_EVENT) & mh.move_kind.isin(YARD_MOVE_KINDS) & mh.to_loc.isin(YARD_TO_LOC)]
cols = ["unit", "frm", "to", "ts"]
moves = pd.concat([ym[cols].assign(src="MH yard move"),
                   pcf[pcf.event == CORR_EVENT][cols].assign(src="N4 correction")], ignore_index=True)
print("Step 1 – move set");  print("   raw:", len(moves), moves.src.value_counts().to_dict())
moves = keep(moves, moves.ts.notna(),                  "has a timestamp")
moves = keep(moves, moves.frm.str.match(STD),          "from = standard slot")
moves = keep(moves, moves.to.str.startswith("Y-PEB-"), "to = yard position")
moves = keep(moves, ~is_prestage(moves.frm),           "from not rail pre-staging")
moves = moves.sort_values(["unit", "ts"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
dup = (moves.unit.eq(moves.unit.shift()) & moves.frm.eq(moves.frm.shift())
       & (moves.ts - moves.ts.shift()).abs().le(DEDUP_MOVE))
moves = keep(moves, ~dup,                                      "10-min duplicates removed")
moves = keep(moves, moves.frm.str[6:13] != moves.to.str[6:13], "tier-only dropped").reset_index(drop=True)
moves["block"] = moves.frm.str[6:10]
moves["row"]   = moves.frm.str[10:12].astype(int)
moves["stack"] = moves.frm.str[12]
moves["ts"]    = moves.ts.astype("datetime64[ns]")
print("   by source:", moves.src.value_counts().to_dict())

# ---------- Step 2: loads ----------
ldm = mh[(mh.event == LOAD_EVENT) & mh.move_kind.isin(LOAD_MOVE_KINDS) & mh.to_loc.isin(LOAD_TO_LOC)]
lc = ["unit", "frm", "ts"]
loads = pd.concat([ldm[lc].assign(src="MH load"),
                   pcf[pcf.event == LOAD_EVENT][lc].assign(src="N4 load")], ignore_index=True)
print("\nStep 2 – load set");  print("   raw:", len(loads), loads.src.value_counts().to_dict())
loads = keep(loads, loads.ts.notna(),         "has a timestamp")
loads = keep(loads, loads.frm.str.match(STD), "from = standard slot")
loads = loads.rename(columns={"unit": "load_unit", "frm": "lfrm", "ts": "tf"})
loads = loads.sort_values(["load_unit", "tf"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
ldup = loads.load_unit.eq(loads.load_unit.shift()) & (loads.tf - loads.tf.shift()).abs().le(DEDUP_LOAD)
loads = keep(loads, ~ldup, "2-h duplicates removed").reset_index(drop=True)
loads["block"] = loads.lfrm.str[6:10]
loads["row"]   = loads.lfrm.str[10:12].astype(int)
loads["stack"] = loads.lfrm.str[12]
loads["tf"]    = loads.tf.astype("datetime64[ns]")

# Rule A – rehandle: first load after the move, same block + stack, row -1/0/+1, within 2 h, different unit
moves["rehandle"] = False
moves["rh_load_unit"], moves["rh_load_pos"], moves["rh_load_time"] = None, None, pd.NaT
ls = loads.sort_values("tf")[["block", "stack", "row", "tf", "load_unit", "lfrm"]]
for off in (0, -1, 1):                                  # same row first, so the recorded trigger prefers it
    m = (moves[["unit", "block", "stack", "row", "ts"]]
         .assign(row=moves.row + off).reset_index().sort_values("ts"))   # 'index' = original move id
    j = pd.merge_asof(m, ls, left_on="ts", right_on="tf", by=["block", "stack", "row"],
                      direction="forward", tolerance=LOAD_WINDOW)
    j = j[j.tf.notna() & (j.load_unit != j.unit)].set_index("index")
    first = j.index.difference(moves.index[moves.rehandle])
    moves.loc[first, "rh_load_unit"] = j.loc[first, "load_unit"]
    moves.loc[first, "rh_load_pos"]  = j.loc[first, "lfrm"]
    moves.loc[first, "rh_load_time"] = j.loc[first, "tf"]
    moves.loc[j.index, "rehandle"] = True
moves["minutes_to_load"] = ((moves.rh_load_time - moves.ts).dt.total_seconds() / 60).round(1)

# Rule B – housekeeping: not a rehandle and the box changed row or block
same_block = moves.frm.str[6:10] == moves.to.str[6:10]
moves["housekeeping"] = ~moves.rehandle & (moves.frm.str[6:12] != moves.to.str[6:12])
moves["hk_rr"] = moves.housekeeping & same_block
moves["hk_bb"] = moves.housekeeping & ~same_block

# Rule C – excluded: same-row shuffle with no load after it
moves["excluded"] = ~moves.rehandle & ~moves.housekeeping

# open decision in the spec: adjacent-row, no-stack corrections (flagged, not removed)
to_row = pd.to_numeric(moves.to.str[10:12], errors="coerce")
moves["hk_adjacent_nostack"] = (moves.housekeeping & ~moves.to.str.match(STD) & same_block
                                & (to_row - moves.row).abs().eq(1))

moves["class"] = "Excluded (same row)"
moves.loc[moves.hk_rr, "class"] = "Housekeeping row-to-row"
moves.loc[moves.hk_bb, "class"] = "Housekeeping block-to-block"
moves.loc[moves.rehandle, "class"] = "Rehandle"
print(pd.crosstab(moves["class"], moves.src, margins=True).to_string())

if PERIOD == "auto":
    pts = pc.loc[(pc.event == CORR_EVENT) & (pc.status == FCL_PC), "ts"]
    p_start, p_end = max(mh.ts.min(), pts.min()).normalize(), min(mh.ts.max(), pts.max()).normalize()
else:
    p_start, p_end = pd.Timestamp(PERIOD[0]), pd.Timestamp(PERIOD[1])
in_period = lambda s: s.dt.normalize().between(p_start, p_end) & ~s.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d").isin(EXCLUDE_DAYS)
mv = moves[in_period(moves.ts)].copy()
ld = loads[in_period(loads.tf)].copy()
print(f"Period: {p_start:%Y-%m-%d} -> {p_end:%Y-%m-%d} | excluded days: {EXCLUDE_DAYS or 'none'}")

mv["date"], ld["date"] = mv.ts.dt.normalize(), ld.tf.dt.normalize()
mv["wk"] = (mv.date - GO_LIVE).dt.days // 7          # 0 = W0 (28 Sep), negative = before go-live
ld["wk"] = (ld.date - GO_LIVE).dt.days // 7

CNT = ["loads", "rehandles", "housekeeping", "hk_row_to_row", "hk_block_to_block",
       "hk_adjacent_nostack", "excluded_same_row", "moves", "days_with_data"]

def rollup(key):
    g = mv.groupby(key)
    t = pd.DataFrame({
        "moves": g.size(), "rehandles": g.rehandle.sum(), "housekeeping": g.housekeeping.sum(),
        "hk_row_to_row": g.hk_rr.sum(), "hk_block_to_block": g.hk_bb.sum(),
        "hk_adjacent_nostack": g.hk_adjacent_nostack.sum(), "excluded_same_row": g.excluded.sum(),
        "days_with_data": g.date.nunique()})
    t = t.join(ld.groupby(key).size().rename("loads"), how="outer").fillna(0)[CNT].astype(int)
    dd = t.days_with_data.where(t.days_with_data > 0)
    t["rehandles_per_100_loads"]  = (100 * t.rehandles / t.loads.where(t.loads > 0)).round(1)
    t["housekeeping_per_day"]     = (t.housekeeping / dd).round(1)
    t["hk_per_day_excl_adjacent"] = ((t.housekeeping - t.hk_adjacent_nostack) / dd).round(1)
    return t.reset_index()

weekly, daily = rollup("wk"), rollup("date")
daily["wk"] = (daily.date - GO_LIVE).dt.days // 7
for t in (weekly, daily):
    ws  = GO_LIVE + pd.to_timedelta(t.wk * 7, unit="D")
    iso = ws.dt.isocalendar()
    t["week_start"]   = ws.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    t["iso_week"]     = iso.year.astype(str) + "-W" + iso.week.astype(str).str.zfill(2)
    t["go_live_week"] = t.wk.map(lambda n: "W0" if n == 0 else f"W{n:+d}")
weekly["reportable"] = weekly.loads >= MIN_LOADS_WEEK
daily["date"] = daily.date.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

lead = ["week_start", "iso_week", "go_live_week"]
weekly = weekly[lead + ["reportable"] + [c for c in weekly.columns if c not in lead + ["wk", "reportable"]]]
daily  = daily[["date"] + lead + [c for c in daily.columns if c not in lead + ["date", "wk"]]]

pre = weekly[weekly.go_live_week.isin([f"W-{n}" for n in range(2, 9)]) & weekly.reportable]
if len(pre):
    print(f"Before go-live ({len(pre)} weeks): rehandles/100 loads = {pre.rehandles_per_100_loads.mean():.1f}, "
          f"housekeeping/day = {pre.housekeeping_per_day.mean():.0f}")

# exports: full tables, not limited by display()
mssparkutils.fs.mkdirs(OUT)
mssparkutils.fs.put(OUT + "rehandle_hk_weekly.csv", weekly.to_csv(index=False), True)
mssparkutils.fs.put(OUT + "rehandle_hk_daily.csv",  daily.to_csv(index=False),  True)
(spark.createDataFrame(moves).write.mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true")
      .format("delta").save(OUT + "delta/rehandle_hk_moves"))
print(f"Saved: weekly {len(weekly)} rows, daily {len(daily)} rows, classified moves {len(moves):,} rows")

display(spark.createDataFrame(weekly))

def trace(unit):
    u = unit.strip().upper()
    m = moves[moves.unit == u].sort_values("ts")
    if m.empty:
        print(f"{u}: no moves in the move set (check raw data: mh[mh.unit == '{u}'], pc[pc.unit == '{u}'])"); return
    for _, r in m.iterrows():
        print(f"\n{r.ts}  {r.src:<14} {r.frm} -> {r.to}  =>  {r['class']}"
              + (f"  (triggered by {r.rh_load_unit} from {r.rh_load_pos} at {r.rh_load_time}, {r.minutes_to_load} min)"
                 if r.rehandle else ""))
        cand = loads[(loads.block == r.block) & (loads.stack == r.stack) & loads.row.between(r.row - 1, r.row + 1)
                     & (loads.tf >= r.ts) & (loads.tf <= r.ts + LOAD_WINDOW)].sort_values("tf")
        print("   loads in same block/stack, rows ±1, next 2 h (Rule A uses only the FIRST per row):")
        print(cand[["load_unit", "lfrm", "tf"]].to_string(index=False) if len(cand) else "   none")

trace("MRKU5907934")    # replace with any container number
